facts.fact: The OGP record says Kenya launched the Kenya Open Data Initiative portal (Opendata.go.ke) in 2011 to make government-held data accessible to the public; it also says the portal has been offline for the last few years.

systems.system: Budget Data portal (planned, National Treasury, due July 2025)

note: Licence is stated only as KODI's objective, not as a fact; portal offline in the document's time (2023), budget portal planned, so no stage-1 'none' statement.
